name: NFWF Bats for the Future Fund
summary: Competitive grants, funded with the US Fish and Wildlife Service, for field treatments, habitat conservation and research to limit white-nose syndrome and recover affected bat species such as the northern long-eared and Indiana bats.

amount.note: Requests must exceed $50,000 and should be no more than $250,000; larger amounts may be considered.

eligibility.rule: Has a relevant land-agency PI or collaborator and relevant support statements
Project is not ongoing legal compliance (permits, mitigation, settlements); enhancing baseline compliance is fine

eligibility.quote: Each proposal must include at least one Principal Investigator or collaborator from a land management agency with jurisdiction over proposed field sites and statements of support from any relevant land management agencies or landowners where fieldwork will be conducted.

NFWF funds may not be used to support ongoing efforts to comply with legal requirements, including permit conditions, mitigation and settlement agreements. However, grant funds may be used to support projects that enhance or improve upon existing baseline compliance efforts.
